description: Defect: the Explorer pipeline excludes bundles that have a known-defects sidecar (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py:666 _sidecar_known_defects, applied at :1695 and :1820, reason known_defective_data), but results-data/validate_corpus.py:568 exclusion_reason never reads that sidecar. The corpus depth gate and cohort identity counts therefore include bundles the Explorer will not rank. Found 2026-10-16 comparing outcomes after #3075: validate_corpus reports TPC-H SF 0.1 with 8 identities (including BigQuery, Databricks and Snowflake), while the Explorer ranks 6 rows and excludes those three cloud bundles, plus most legacy SF 0.01/0.1 rows, as known_defective_data. Pre-existing; not introduced by #3075.
